comments.body: Correction (evidence check r1 of the record): the driver pressed no keys once the prompt was on screen, under its frozen stop rule, so whether `/security` could have been reached from that prompt (for example via "o to open thread" or Esc) was **not tested**. The original "there's no way to reach /security" overstated it. The question for the owner stands: how should AGG-R03 reach the kill switch while another pane's prompt is pending?
Owner decision (Travis, 2026-10-15, as recommended): re-test AGG-R03 from a second Corbanu Terminal on the same home.

title: Kill switch unreachable while another pane's approval prompt is pending (AGG-R03): the prompt takes over the current pane
